scenarios.prompt: An arena combines traversal pressure, a resource objective and two participant groups. Model it as a stable beat/state graph.

criteria.identity: encounter_id/revision and stable beat/state IDs are explicit.
criteria.transitions: Entry/fail/retry/reset/exit behavior is deterministic and idempotent.
criteria.ownership: Spawn, difficulty, participant kits and rewards remain with their owning skills.
